display_long_description:
# 🧗 Santa Climber – Grip It. Swing It. Don't Fall.

One candy cane in each hand. A towering obstacle course ahead. And absolutely no guarantee you'll make it to the top. Swing, grip, recover, and somehow keep moving upward — even when everything around you is working against it.

# 🌀 Chaos is the Point

No two runs are the same. Slippery surfaces, moving platforms, unpredictable physics, and the beautiful disaster of other players make every attempt feel fresh. You'll fall. A lot. But getting back up is half the fun.

# NEW:🗼 Tower Mode

A vertical endurance test unlike anything else in the game. The Tower gets tighter, faster, and meaner the higher you go. No checkpoints. No mercy. Just you, your candy canes, and the question of how far you can actually get.

# 👥 Climb Together. Suffer Together.

Jump in solo or bring friends into the chaos. Race each other to the top, accidentally knock each other off ledges, or team up and watch it still go wrong somehow. 
[media]


# 🗺️ Choose Your Arena

– 🏔️ Classic Mode – The full climbing experience. Obstacles, surprises, and a long way down if you slip.
– 🔥 Floor is Lava – The floor is rising. The pressure is real. Keep climbing or face the consequences.
– 🏭 Factory Mode – Industrial chaos with unpredictable layouts that keep you guessing every step of the way.


# 🎨 Make Your Santa Yours

Pick from a growing roster of Santa skins and customize how you look on the climb. New styles drop regularly — so there's always a reason to check back in.
[media]
